_metadata.purpose: Synthetic demonstration data for AuditAI prototype testing ONLY.
_metadata.real_world_note: This contract is FICTITIOUS. Real enterprise MSAs contain hundreds of pages of legal prose, complex tariff rate sheets, lane-specific pricing, and multi-tiered index adjustment formulas. This simplified fixture tests the engine's core logic but does NOT represent the complexity of real-world contracts.
_metadata.leakage_note: The paired sample invoice (INV-9042) is deliberately engineered to show ~26% leakage for demonstration purposes. Real-world industry recovery rates are typically 1% to 3% of total spend, not 26%.

clauses.section_4_1: Section 4.1 (Base Freight): Standard linehaul rates shall strictly not exceed $2.40 per route mile for Class-A dry van trailers.
clauses.section_5_3: Section 5.3 (Fuel Adjustment): Fuel surcharge is calculated strictly against base linehaul and is capped at a maximum of 12.0% regardless of national index fluctuations.
clauses.section_6_2: Section 6.2 (Detention & Wait Time): The initial 2.0 hours at origin or destination are free of charge. Excess hours are billable at $50.00/hour.
clauses.section_8_4: Section 8.4 (Tiered Volume Rebate): A 5.0% rebate applies across all qualifying monthly billing if aggregate shipment volume exceeds 50 loads.
